GENERALITY NOTES: (1) element-rooted block pa-timeline__item carries its own 8 modifiers (--primary…--info, --filled, --date-header), caught by the reverse check. (2) Its parts are FLAT SIBLINGS under pa-timeline__ (pa-timeline__time/__content/__date-label), claimed via features' produces + goldens. (3) SCOPE: this covers the simple/marker/date-header layouts where BOTH wrappers agree (item = <li>, content raw).
